title: Os8088: A powerful Mac-like OS for the IBM XT, 286, 386
summary: Os8088 is a retro-computing project that brings a Mac-like operating system to vintage IBM PCs (XT, 286, 386). It focuses on recreating a classic GUI experience on limited hardware, emphasizing efficiency and nostalgia. The project is discussed on Hacker News, highlighting technical challenges and community interest.
